caption: A brief interior cockpit view opens with a camouflaged arm raised against the windshield, then an exterior aerial shot shows a grey military helicopter marked with a white medical cross. The aircraft is already damaged, its upper fuselage burning. A thick dark smoke plume trails from the burning aircraft as it drifts and rotates low over a manicured green lawn bordered by trees and a white colonnaded building. The helicopter banks at varying angles while its rotor blades sweep. As the tracking camera follows, a circular fountain appears and the tilted aircraft descends toward the ground, where a bright flare bursts beneath it beside the fountain.
